test_ComputeSupport_node_supports: test ComputeSupport by accumulating a graph of Bernoulli random variables and verifying computed support values
test_ComputeSupport_bernoulli_support: test ComputeSupport with a 2D Bernoulli distribution and verify all four sample combinations
test_ComputeSupport_categorical_support: test ComputeSupport with Categorical distributions of varying batch sizes and check for TooBig on large supports
test_ComputeSupport_infinite_support: test ComputeSupport with a Normal distribution and verify it returns the Infinite sentinel
test_ComputeSupport_switch_support: test ComputeSupport with stochastic control flow that switches between Normal and Bernoulli distributions
